EventData.title: EventData
EventData.description: Specifies the data for the complete show or a single event

Content.title: Content
Content.description: This is not expected to be present for comments, program headers and break headers, but is expected in all other cases.

AlternateAudioContent.description: If audio not directly associated with the primary video content is scheduled to run with the video a separate content for just this audio must be indicated.

ContentType.title: ContentType
ContentType.description: Used to describe the type of content (eg. network, local, entertainment, news) (See Configuration Section in BXF Protocol Documentation)

Formats.title: Formats
Formats.description: The definition of the empty structure of a program as used by the traffic system to construct a schedule grid.

FormatId.title: FormatId
FormatId.description: The unique identifier for a format

EventData.title: EventData
EventData.description: Specifies the data for the complete show or a single event

AlternateAudioContent.description: If audio not directly associated with the primary video content is scheduled to run with the video a separate content for just this audio must be indicated.

Content.title: Content
Content.description: This is not expected to be present for comments, program headers and break headers, but is expected in all other cases.

MultiContent.title: MultiContent
MultiContent.description: Intended in cases where you would have more than one program content embedded within a single program such as compilation programs, cartoons, etc. (v4.0)

ScheduleElements.description: Specifies the elemental structure of the show

ParentalRating.description: Parental rating for the show for one region (PMCP)

EiCode.title: EiCode
EiCode.description: Used for FCC Education/Information Children's code

ContentPlayNumber.title: ContentPlayNumber
ContentPlayNumber.description: The play number value relative to the contract used to authorize the content or the total times the content has been used on the schedule.

PremiereFlag.title: PremiereFlag
PremiereFlag.description: Used to indicate that this is the first airing of the content on this schedule.

LastPlayFlag.title: LastPlayFlag
LastPlayFlag.description: Used to indicate that this is the last airing of the content on this schedule.

TransformationOutput.title: TransformationOutput
TransformationOutput.description: Used to create a transformation of the video from its current stored value to a different transmission value.

AlternateScheduleEventFlag.title: AlternateScheduleEventFlag
AlternateScheduleEventFlag.description: Allows linkage to standby promo content or other content that serve as backups or alternatives to content that may be missing at airtime.  Must be set to "1" and include a LinkedEventId that indicates which event this is a backup to.  Note that there is also a new AlternateEvent element that allows the definition of alternative content underneath a specific Event.

PlayoutRestrictions.description: Used to define what is allowed or restricted to the viewing of content in different venues (locations, devices, etc.) and the provisioning of alternative content when this happens.  Each Venue may have only one replacement option or null.

SeriesName.title: SeriesName
SeriesName.description: The name assigned to represent a related group of produced content.

EpisodeName.title: EpisodeName
EpisodeName.description: A distinct name (within the series) assigned by the producer of the content.

EpisodeCode.title: EpisodeCode
EpisodeCode.description: The identifier that uniquely specifies a title in a series

Season.title: Season

SeasonName.title: SeasonName
SeasonName.description: The name used to reference the season period

SeasonCode.title: SeasonCode
SeasonCode.description: Indicates the value for the season within the full episode code.

Season.description: A date range that indicates the period of time in which the episode was originally produced

SeriesCode.title: SeriesCode
SeriesCode.description: The series prefix or code that applies to all episodes that are part of the series - eg. SESA for Sesame Street.

EpisodeNumber.title: EpisodeNumber
EpisodeNumber.description: The value associated with the epsiode relative to the full EpisodeCode (eg. SESAHDBA0110 then this would be 0110).  May contain non-numeric characters.

Producers.description: Companies that are involved in the production or distribution of the series.

Synopses.title: Synopses
Synopses.description: Allow the addition of one or more synopses of various lengths and for different purposes in multiple languages. (v5.0)
